comment: Accepted documents of rule 9 of tools/check-docs.mjs. Each one was accepted before the rule held and is never edited again, so its measured quantities are history. Do not add an entry for a new document: say what the number shows in words, and link the audit or name the code by path.

allow.reason: An accepted record that quotes the claim time that it measured. A record does not change after it is accepted.
An accepted record that quotes the size of the style sheet that it weighed. A record does not change after it is accepted.
An accepted record that names the time budget of its external source, The Performance Inequality Gap, 2026. A later edition of the source is a new record.
An accepted record that quotes the cost that pnpm perf:service measured. A record does not change after it is accepted.
The plan of release 0.1, kept as the record of the decisions behind it. Record 0136 replaced its budget figure, and the plan is not edited again.
